title: design_proposal/1: the design the sample names suggest, with each automatic choice
description: The answer of `mzlab-cli sample design propose`: the proposed design/1 (the very bytes of the engine's `design_propose` route), every automatic choice with its value and the reason, and the evidence it came from. The user decides: edit the design or keep it; `--out` writes the bare design/1 for a plan's `design` input. Code: crates/mzlab-cli/src/design_cmd.rs.

choices.description: conditions, reference, comparisons and batches, in that order

value.description: conditions: the names; reference: a name or null; comparisons: vs_reference or none; batches: the default batch

why.description: the stable code of the reason

reason.description: the sentence of that code (lang/en err.design.why.<code>)

min_replicates.description: fewer files per time point than this make `validate` warn fewReplicates

sample_files.description: the files with the role sample

files.description: the sample files of the condition, in the order of injection
